place.source_title: Old Wabash Hotel, Main & Union Streets

brief: Old stagecoach hotel of about 1839 on a corner: two and a half storeys of brick with stepped parapet gable ends and chimneys, a row of dormers, and a ground floor now split into shops. Record: 1 photo plus 4 measured drawing sheets.

floors: W W W W W W
facade.notes: the Old Wabash Hotel (Edwardsville IL, 1839): a 2.5-storey brick tavern-hotel with stepped gable ends, three dormers, its ground floor now a tavern, fish market and lunch room with signs; on a corner sidewalk; a mailbox
